Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The document details administrative procedures for remote e-voting and video conferencing, alongside special and ordinary business items. Key items include the re-appointment of directors and the review of audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026. Management stated that Calsoft focused its strategy in FY 2024-25 on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible, AI-driven solutions like dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo. The company highlighted that global AI adoption among small businesses surged significantly, with dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem growing to over 1,000 merchants and achieving a 95% annual client retention rate.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that around 80% of small business owners view AI as an enabler that enhances their workforce rather than a replacement.
demand_outlook.quote: Crucially, most entrepreneurs see AI as an enabler of growth rather than a threat: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that approximately 68% of small business owners report using AI, marking a sharp increase from 51% two years prior.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: Surveys show that over 80% of small businesses adopting AI have increased efficiency and productivity.
demand_outlook.quote: Surveys also show over 80% of small businesses adopting AI have increased efficiency and productivity, and more than half report AI provides better data for decision-making and new capabilities for expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that 58% of small businesses utilized generative AI in 2025, which represents an increase from 40% in 2024.
demand_outlook.quote: Generative AI Adoption: 58% of SMBs reported using generative AI in 2025, up from 40% in 2024, with marketing as the top use case (U.S. Chamber Report).

demand_outlook.claim: Nearly two-thirds of small businesses expressed optimism that AI will assist them in navigating economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: Nearly two-thirds of small businesses in surveys expressed optimism that AI will help them navigate economic uncertainty by providing better forecasts and insights.

orders_capacity.claim: Calsoft's dSpeedUp digital ecosystem expanded to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving a 95% annual client retention rate.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that many small enterprises continue to face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported lacking the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: The company stated that the results of voting will be declared within 48 hours from the conclusion of the Annual General Meeting.
management_commitments.quote: The results of voting will be declared within 48 hours from the conclusion of the Annual General Meeting.

management_commitments.claim: Management affirmed that Calsoft remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts entrepreneurs and ensures broad innovation.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

management_commitments.claim: The Chairman expressed a commitment to ensuring innovation is accessible to all stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: Over these years, we have remained committed to a single purpose: to ensure that innovation is not limited to a few but accessible to all.

management_commitments.claim: The CEO stated a commitment to ensuring that AI is accessible, affordable, and impactful for entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: At Calsofts, we consider it our moral and strategic responsibility to ensure that AI is accessible, affordable, and impactful for the millions of entrepreneurs who need it most.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
